limitations: Diagnostics only: BeastXPy does not claim or assert convergence. A 'pass' verdict means no user-configured diagnostic threshold was crossed, not that the MCMC converged.
BeastXPy does not perform model selection; assess never compares models, marginal likelihoods or Bayes factors (see the separate compare command).
ESS, ACT, PSRF (Gelman-Rubin R-hat) and ASDSF are finite-sample estimates; on short chains they are noisy and must not be read as proof of convergence or divergence.
Statistics whose input columns or chains are missing are reported as not_computable with a reason; BeastXPy never substitutes a guessed value.
